text: Today is the tomorrow I was so worried about yesterday.

Sometimes the light's all shinin' on me
Other times I can barely see
Lately it occurs to me
What a long, strange trip it's been
Give me six hours to chop down a tree, and I will spend the first four sharpening the axe.
Nothing grows in the comfort zone.
It's the job that's never started as takes longest to finish.
attribution: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings

text: Don't stay where you're tolerated; go where you're celebrated.
Be tolerant with others and strict with yourself.
Ability is what you're capable of doing. Motivation determines what you do. Attitude determines how well you do it.
Holding a grudge is like drinking poison and expecting the other person to suffer.
A mule without a carrot gets exhausted; a mule with a carrot spends a long time being tired.
The only easy day was yesterday.
If you're willing to give others the credit, you'll conquer the world.
Treat praise like perfume. Sniff it, don't drink it. It's poison.
A delay is better than a disaster.
Make sure the main thing is the main thing.
You're never on time; you're either early or late.
A shut mouth catches no flies.
From a hundred rabbits you can't make a horse.

When nothing seems to help, I go and look at a stonecutter hammering away at his rock, perhaps a hundred times without as much as a crack showing in it. Yet at the hundred and first blow it will split in two, and I know it was not that blow that did it, but all that had gone before.
You can't be great without the greatness of others.
Money is like Miracle-Gro: if you're a good guy, it will make you a better guy; if you're an asshole, it will make you a bigger asshole.
The opposite of love is not hate. The opposite of love is indifference.
If I look at the mass, I will never act. If I look at the one, I will.
Routine is the death of awareness.
If we all think alike, no one is thinking.
Perfection is finally attained not when there is no longer anything to add, but when there is no longer anything to take away.
Don't compare me to the Almighty. Compare me to the alternative.
If you don't look back at yourself and think, 'Wow, how stupid I was a year ago,' then you must not have learned much in the last year.
Ignorance more frequently begets confidence than does knowledge.
The biggest window in a car is the windshield, so keep looking forward.
When you lose, say little. When you win, say less.
There is no courage without fear.
What is delayed is not denied.
If you are prepared for the worst, you are prepared for anything.
Don't ever get too good at a job you don't want.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
Nothing will kill a great employee faster than watching you tolerate a bad one.
Man proposes, and God disposes.

Watch your thoughts, for they will become actions. Watch your actions, for they will become habits. Watch your habits, for they will forge your character. Watch your character, for it will make your destiny.
People are strange: they are constantly angered by trivial things, but on a major matter like wasting their lives, they hardly seem to notice.
No man ever steps in the same river twice.
You can either be brave or pretend to be brave, but it's pretty much the same thing.
Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced.
When you hear hoofbeats, think of horses, not zebras.
In a short time, this will be a long time ago.
When no one is to blame, everyone is to blame.
Any jackass can kick down a barn, but it takes a good carpenter to build one.
If you possess something but you can't give it away, then you don't possess it. It possesses you.
Never tell people how to do things. Tell them what to do and they will surprise you with their ingenuity.
Dissatisfaction is a symptom of ambition. It's the coal that fuels the fire.
Always do sober what you said you'd do drunk. That will teach you to keep your mouth shut.
I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
When you talk, you are only repeating what you already know. But if you listen, you may learn something new.
Growth is painful. Change is painful. But nothing is as painful as being stuck where you do not belong.
Enjoy the little things, for one day you may look back and realize they were the big things.
Be curious. Read widely. Try new things. I think a lot of what people call intelligence just boils down to curiosity.
The only disability in life is a bad attitude.
Be not afraid of growing slowly; be afraid only of standing still.
The master has failed more times than the beginner has even tried.
Those who cannot change their minds cannot change anything.
Pigs get fat, hogs get slaughtered.
Victory has a hundred fathers and defeat is an orphan.
A puppet is free as long as he loves his strings.
Nobody is eager for a lecture, but everybody loves a story.
Sometimes when things are falling apart, they may actually be falling into place.
Change the I to an E. Don't get bitter, get better.
Ability may get you to the top, but it takes character to keep you there.
The first sign of a bad boss is that he wins every argument.
Never underestimate how wrong you can be.
You can't get the wisdom of crowds if the crowd isn't wise.
The dullest pencil remembers more than the sharpest mind.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Friction makes fire.
History doesn't repeat, but it rhymes.
When you march to the beat of your own drum, you risk losing the band.
Inspiration comes to the prepared mind.
There are no good or bad events; there's only perception.
The strength of the Wolf is the Pack.
Be unapologetically you when you talk to someone, because that lets them be unapologetically them.
Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
